steps.title: T2-BUILDPLACE: a SEVERE, previously-undiscovered GAME defect

args.text: FINDING-T2-BUILDPLACE-2026-08-30.md, round 2 (the loud flag): scripts/combat/encounter_director.gd::interaction_offer() (line ~1037) returns a priority-100, distance-0 "<ally> is out of the fight." statement UNCONDITIONALLY whenever the tracked `_ally` has fainted -- with NO proximity gate, checked BEFORE _engageable(). prompt_arbiter.gd ranks priority before distance always ("distance at all and still has to beat a creature nine metres away"), so this one line outranks EVERY OTHER INTERACTION IN THE WORLD -- not just re-engaging a wild creature, but every village NPC greeting, every harvest node, every creature bed's own rest prompt -- for as long as `_ally` stays non-null and fainted, which (per RIG-13's own finding) only a fresh save/load clears, never gameplay on its own. Live-confirmed this run: after the catch loop's own real, non-buggy, RIG-15-acknowledged possible outcome (a starter fainting on a real throw), S03-53's interact_with(Mira) FAILed with the live prompt reading exactly "Ripplet is out of the fight." -- not a wrong-prompt bug at Mira, a WORLD-WIDE interaction lockout. A real player whose only starter faints during these exact opening catch attempts cannot catch a replacement (catching is ALSO interaction_offer()-gated and _engageable() is checked AFTER the blanket clause), cannot talk to any NPC, cannot gather, and cannot reach a creature bed's rest prompt -- for the rest of that play session, with no in-game affordance suggesting a save+reload is the only way out. This reads as a genuine, previously-undocumented SOFT-LOCK risk in the opening tutorial and is reported as such, loudly, per this lane's own brief. Out of this lane's ownership (scripts/combat/**, actively edited by T3-TYPECHART) and NOT fixed here. The workaround below is rig-side only, so this validation run's own exit save is not itself proof the game is safe for a real player.
